key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, pinnatifid to deeply divided into narrow segments.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Disk strongly elongated/columnar, becoming tall and cylindrical; rays drooping, yellow or sometimes bicolored.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Cypselae with small crownlike pappus scales.
